shape.text: The shape recorded is the literal key- followed by 32 characters from lowercase letters and digits. One scanner rule matches it without a keyword, another requires a mailgun keyword and hexadecimal characters only, and a third agrees. Mailgun's own PHP SDK test uses a signing key with letters beyond f, so the body is not hexadecimal-only.

The one provider example of the key- shape is for the HTTP webhook signing key, shown in the account management reference, so this family covers the private API key and the signing key under one shape.

unresolved.reason: No source states whether the body is case-sensitive or whether uppercase occurs.
